reading.title: PAYMENT IN LIEU OF TAXES AND REGULATORY AGREEMENT

candidates.quote: The Owner is building an 80-home rental project at 2200 Beacon Avenue (the "Project").
By Resolution No. 2025-41, adopted May 13, 2025, the City Council approved a payment in lieu of taxes for the Project, subject to this Agreement.
candidates.wording: approved a payment in lieu of taxes
candidates.value: payment in lieu of taxes approved by Resolution No. 2025-41

candidates.quote: "Area Median Income" means the median income for Bayside County, adjusted for household size, as published each year by HUD.
candidates.wording: means the median income for Bayside County, adjusted for household size, as published each year by HUD
candidates.value: Bayside County median income, adjusted for household size, published annually by HUD

candidates.quote: The Owner shall pay the City an annual payment in lieu of taxes equal to 25 percent of the property taxes that would otherwise be due, for a period of 15 years.
candidates.wording: shall pay the City an annual payment in lieu of taxes equal to 25 percent
candidates.value: annual PILOT equal to 25% of property taxes otherwise due for 15 years

candidates.quote: Payments are due each year on the date property taxes would otherwise be due.
candidates.value: due each year on date property taxes would otherwise be due

candidates.quote: The Owner shall reserve 16 of the 80 homes in the Project as Affordable Homes.
Each Affordable Home shall be leased to a household with income at or below 60 percent of Area Median Income.
candidates.wording: shall be leased to a household with income at or below 60 percent of Area Median Income
candidates.value: at or below 60% of Area Median Income

candidates.quote: Monthly rent for each Affordable Home, including a utility allowance, shall not exceed the 60 percent rent limit based on the HUD income limits published each year.
candidates.wording: shall not exceed the 60 percent rent limit
candidates.value: at or below 60% rent limit, including utility allowance, based on annual HUD limits

candidates.quote: The requirements of this Article 3 shall remain in effect for 30 years from the date the first Affordable Home is leased.
candidates.wording: shall remain in effect for 30 years
candidates.value: 30 years from date first Affordable Home is leased

candidates.quote: Affordable Homes shall be spread through the Project and shall have the same finishes as other homes of the same size.
candidates.wording: shall be spread through the Project and shall have the same finishes
candidates.value: spread through Project with same finishes as other homes of same size

candidates.quote: The Owner is responsible for compliance with this Agreement, and this Agreement binds every later owner of the Project.
candidates.wording: is responsible for compliance with this Agreement, and this Agreement binds every later owner

candidates.quote: The Owner shall give the City 30 days' written notice before any sale of the Project.
candidates.wording: shall give the City 30 days' written notice before any sale
candidates.value: 30 days' written notice to City before sale

candidates.quote: The Owner shall deliver an annual compliance certificate to the City by March 1 of each year.
candidates.wording: shall deliver an annual compliance certificate
candidates.value: annual compliance certificate due by March 1

candidates.quote: The certificate shall state counts only and shall not include household names or other personal information.
candidates.wording: shall state counts only and shall not include household names
candidates.value: state counts only, no household names or personal info

candidates.quote: The City may inspect the Owner's leasing records for the Affordable Homes on 10 days' notice.
candidates.wording: may inspect the Owner's leasing records
candidates.value: inspect leasing records on 10 days' notice

candidates.quote: The City shall give the Owner written notice of any default under this Agreement.
candidates.wording: shall give the Owner written notice of any default

candidates.quote: If a default is not cured within 60 days after written notice, the Owner shall repay all abated taxes with interest.
candidates.wording: shall repay all abated taxes with interest
candidates.value: repay abated taxes with interest if not cured within 60 days

candidates.quote: The City may also seek any other remedy available at law or in equity.
candidates.wording: may also seek any other remedy
candidates.value: any other remedy available at law or in equity

candidates.quote: This Agreement shall be recorded and runs with the land.
